releases.name: v0.3.0 — first npm release
releases.body:
## v0.3.0 — 2026-09-22 (first npm release)

Self-maintained vision router plugin for OpenCode (renamed fork of `Chathula/opencode-vision-router@0.2.0`, MIT).

### What it does

Pasted images are intercepted at the harness level and routed to a cheap vision model whose text output the text-only main agent works from. Multimodal main models skip the extra routing (`force: false`).

### Fixed since upstream 0.2.0

- V2 capability detection: `ctx.model` with `ctx.catalog.model` fallback (fixes `TypeError` that forced every image through the subagent).
- Regression tests for the V2 capability path.
- Quota/rate-limit fallback chain across ordered vision models.

### Install

```jsonc
// opencode.jsonc
{
  "plugins": [
    {
      "package": "opencode-multimodal-looker",
      "options": { "model": "alibaba-coding-plan/qwen3.7-plus" }
    }
  ]
}
```

```bash
npm i opencode-multimodal-looker
```

Directory-path loading still works (see README). Restart opencode after changing config — plugins are not hot-reloaded.

### Verification

- 40 Bun tests, `tsc --noEmit`, and dist-in-sync CI all pass on the tagged commit.
- `npm view opencode-multimodal-looker version` → `0.3.0`.

**Full diff vs upstream**: https://github.com/Chathula/opencode-vision-router/compare/0.2.0...main (fork point) · **Repo**: https://github.com/nxxxsooo/opencode-multimodal-looker
